summary: Register an EventEmitter listener without deduplication and return the same emitter.

target.notes: Must append the listener, preserve repeated identical registrations, return the emitter, emit 'newListener' before insertion when observed, and invoke listeners later through existing function-call semantics.

semantics.newListener: emitted before the listener is added
semantics.listener_this: ordinary functions receive emitter; arrow lexical this remains governed by FUNCTIONS rules

caveats: Do not use += on a C# event as the semantic model: EventEmitter listener inspection/removal/meta-events are observable.
eventName is a string or Symbol; do not silently ToString arbitrary keys.

tests.name: duplicates are kept
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; function f(){n++} e.on('x',f); e.on('x',f); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);
